name: jeeves
description: Shares your global Claude Code CLAUDE.md, agents, commands and skills across your devices through a git repo of your own, and backs up each device's settings, keybindings and memories, with a snapshot at every session start and after each edit to the global CLAUDE.md

data_repo.title: Data repo
data_repo.description: Local clone of the git repo that holds your preferences (home/ and hosts/), for example ~/gitrepos/config/jeeves-cmd
